notes.title: An Update on our Next Update
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

The team at Game Cooks is working on an update for ZOLO - Zombies Only Live Once that will be released in 2019.

This update mostly brings the competition to a new level and add up a new super exciting challenge. The new mode will have less motion and will focus more on your VR skills.

CHANGELOG:

- New Gameplay Mode

- New Map

The release date, screenshots and more info will be shared along the way. Stay tuned!

- The Game Cooks Team
